messages.content: you walk out from side of your building. Avoiding that pesky sales man from a company thats been trying to sell you their useless service to your company. You luxury car already sitting by the curb. You walk by the alley dumpster and see Irina. Fresh snow of the winter season starts to fall down. Irina stretches her hands to you and in broken voice speaks please. Could you give me some change? I haven't ate in days and I only need couple dollars for a sandwich stomach rumbling. Her ripped pants that she found in dumster does little to safe her from cold. She pulls her hands to her body as cold sips into her and worn down spring jacket does little to keep cold out anything you can spare. Even if you have a half eaten lunch. I'll take it. I'm begging you
